author_notes: Slot slot_237 targets amiradeu/threejs.amiradeuraseh.com because it is a stable Vite/Three.js interactive canvas scene with a real source-level asset manifest, multiple GLB models, day-cycle texture sets, art-frame images, HDR/EXR environment maps, DRACO decoder assets, sounds, intro loading state, credits overlay, controls overlay, and responsive canvas states. The regression-continuity asset task repairs the lack of visible asset integrity feedback: a failed model, texture, HDR/EXR, or sound can otherwise leave the intro pipeline opaque and difficult to diagnose. The reference keeps the WebGL scene, cycle controls, credits, and controls overlay intact while adding a source-grounded asset integrity overlay and loader failure accounting.
design_constraints: Keep the Mistwood Cottage WebGL scene, intro overlay, Enter workflow, day-cycle buttons, credits panel, controls overlay, coin counter, camera/physics setup, and existing source asset manifest intact.

Do not replace the Three.js renderer, remove models or texture sets, add remote assets, add dependencies, edit generated dist output as the source of truth, or convert the app into a static screenshot.

The asset integrity UI must be visibly integrated with the existing overlay language: compact, translucent, readable above the canvas, and positioned so it does not block Credits, day-cycle controls, or mobile controls.
Use the existing src/Experience/sources.js entries as the source of truth for counts and featured asset paths; do not hardcode unrelated dummy file names or generic placeholder copy.
The loader should account for failed model/texture/HDR/EXR loads so one bad asset cannot silently strand the user without visible status feedback.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile states must keep the asset overlay text contained and preserve a large nonblank canvas after Enter.

change_completion: A visible ASSET INTEGRITY overlay reports the 46 tracked assets, loaded/failed/pending state, and grouped GLB/TEXTURE/HDR/EXR/AUDIO counts.

The overlay lists real featured assets from sources.js, including roomModel, cottageModel, environmentModel, terrainModel, coinModel, environmentMapTexture, artImage0, and jazzSound with their actual paths.
Resource loading code records per-source status and handles failure callbacks for models, textures, cube textures, HDR/EXR textures, and audio without leaving the loading progress permanently opaque.
The Re-check integrity control re-syncs the verdict readout to Verified 46/46 from live resource state.
design_consistency: The overlay uses the existing Mistwood Cottage translucent overlay style, white text, compact monospace diagnostics, small pills, and responsive positioning rather than a detached admin panel.
The implementation stays in the source component, loader, HTML, and SCSS layers that already govern the app; it does not rely on generated dist edits.
The asset panel remains visible but secondary across intro, entered scene, day-cycle, tablet, and mobile states.
The Credits region mirror panel reuses the shared asset-integrity design language via the asset-integrity-strip--credits region modifier.
regression: The original Mistwood Cottage title, A Story in the Hills subtitle, Enter button, Sunrise/Daylight/Pink Sunset/Night controls, Credits content, controls overlay, canvas, and source attribution remain available.
The Vite build continues to emit the static dist app from the original npm build flow without dependency additions.
Daylight and Night cycle button states remain clickable after entering the scene.
responsive: desktop_initial checks loader-time asset status and original intro copy.
desktop_entered_scene, desktop_daylight_cycle, and desktop_night_cycle verify the asset overlay persists with a nonblank canvas after interactions.
tablet_initial, mobile_initial, mobile_entered_scene, and mobile_night_cycle verify responsive overlay placement and text containment.
desktop_recheck and desktop_credits_open verify the interaction verdict and the cross-region credits mirror panel.

metadata.design_goal: repair a concrete defect while keeping unrelated pages and states stable
metadata.source_repo_kind: Vite and Three.js interactive WebGL cottage scene with source-level resource manifest, model/texture/audio assets, intro loader, day-cycle controls, credits panel, controls overlay, and responsive canvas shell.

problem_statement: Mistwood Cottage is a polished Three.js scene with a large local asset manifest, but the loading flow gives users no durable, visible way to verify which models, textures, HDR/EXR maps, art images, and sounds are actually accounted for. If an asset path regresses, the app only logs errors and the experience can become opaque during loading. Modify the app to add a compact Asset Integrity overlay driven by the existing sources.js manifest. It must show total loaded assets, failed/pending status, grouped GLB/TEXTURE/HDR/EXR/AUDIO counts, and featured real asset path rows while preserving the original WebGL scene, Enter flow, day-cycle controls, credits panel, controls overlay, and responsive canvas behavior.
required_content: A visible ASSET INTEGRITY overlay appears on desktop, tablet, and mobile states.
The overlay reports 46/46 loaded when all current local assets are available and shows 0 failed / ready after loading completes.
The overlay includes grouped GLB 5/5, TEXTURE 30/30, HDR 1/1, EXR 1/1, and AUDIO 9/9 count pills based on the existing sources.js records.
The overlay lists real featured asset rows including roomModel, cottageModel, environmentModel, terrainModel, coinModel, environmentMapTexture, artImage0, and jazzSound with their real paths.
The resource loader records per-source status and advances readiness on handled load failures instead of silently leaving the app without visible asset state.
The original Mistwood Cottage intro, Enter interaction, day-cycle buttons, credits content, controls overlay, and canvas remain available across captured states.
The solution is implemented in source files, not by editing generated dist output or injecting hidden verifier strings.
A Re-check integrity control updates a verdict readout to Verified 46/46 when clicked (desktop_recheck).
The asset integrity panel is also mirrored into the Credits overlay region carrying the asset-integrity-strip--credits region modifier.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the intro/loader state with the asset overlay present and original Mistwood Cottage title copy still visible.
desktop_entered_scene captures the scene after clicking Enter with a large visible canvas and the asset overlay still present.
desktop_daylight_cycle and desktop_night_cycle capture clickable cycle controls after Enter and must preserve the asset overlay and cycle labels.
desktop_credits_open captures the original Credits panel without the asset overlay breaking or replacing it.
tablet_initial, mobile_initial, mobile_entered_scene, and mobile_night_cycle keep the asset overlay readable and contained while preserving the original controls/canvas shell.
desktop_recheck captures the verdict readout after clicking Re-check integrity; the verdict must read Verified 46/46 and not remain the pre-check placeholder.
All states must preserve enough original scene text and UI to distinguish this from a generic diagnostic page.
